hints.title: Row Position Assignment
hints.text: Assign a sequence row number to retain the physical order of records in the table.

hints.title: Group Partitioning by Non-Null Values
hints.text: Compute a running count of non-null drink values ordered by row number to assign each row to its preceding non-null island.

hints.title: Value Imputation
hints.text: Pick the first non-null drink value within each group ordered by row number.

hints.title: Window Function Imputation Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
with ranked as (
    select
        id,
        drink,
        row_number() over () as rn
    from CoffeeShop
),
grouped as (
    select
        id,
        drink,
        rn,
        count(drink) over (order by rn rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as grp
    from ranked
)
select
    id,
    first_value(drink) over (partition by grp order by rn) as drink
from grouped
order by rn;
```

variables: n: number of rows in CoffeeShop
complexity.notes: Row numbering and window partition scans require linear-logarithmic sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated scalar subqueries scanning all preceding rows cause quadratic execution time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window functions process streams in partitioned passes without Cartesian joins.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understands running count technique for forward fill imputation over SQL streams.

import pandas as pd

def change_null_values(coffee_shop: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = coffee_shop.copy()
    df['drink'] = df['drink'].ffill()
    return df[['id', 'drink']]
